PUPPETMASTER-SPINNING_WHEEL.description: The first time you play a card each turn, spin [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Thread[/gold] on ALL enemies.
PUPPETMASTER-SPINNING_WHEEL.title: Spinning Wheel
PUPPETMASTER-CLOCKWORK_UNDERSTUDY.descri: Whenever your [gold]Puppets Perform[/gold], they do so an additional time.
PUPPETMASTER-CLOCKWORK_UNDERSTUDY.flavor: Still learning its lines, but has the moves down.
PUPPETMASTER-CLOCKWORK_UNDERSTUDY.title: Clockwork Understudy
PUPPETMASTER-BOX_OF_SCRAPS.flavor: Holds everything you need to make a puppet. As long as you fill it first.
PUPPETMASTER-BOX_OF_SCRAPS.title: Box of Scraps
PUPPETMASTER-WIRE_CUTTERS.flavor: Can be used for good, or for evil.
PUPPETMASTER-WIRE_CUTTERS.title: Wire Cutters
PUPPETMASTER-AUTO_SPOOLER.description: The first time you [gold]Restring[/gold] each turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
PUPPETMASTER-AUTO_SPOOLER.flavor: A strange contraption of springs and gears that usually cooperates.
PUPPETMASTER-AUTO_SPOOLER.title: Auto-spooler
PUPPETMASTER-RECYCLED_CAPE.flavor: It's got a few-- well, lots of holes in it. But it IS stylish!
PUPPETMASTER-RECYCLED_CAPE.title: Recycled Cape
